sloka: बभन्जुर् वानरास् तत्र प्रचकर्षुः च सागरम् ।ते सालैः च अश्व कर्णैः च धवैर् वम्शैः च वानराः ॥६-२२-५४॥।।
transliteration: babhanjur vānarās tatra pracakarṣuḥ ca sāgaram ।te sālaiḥ ca aśva karṇaiḥ ca dhavair vamśaiḥ ca vānarāḥ ॥6-22-54॥।।

translations.english: The Vanaras brought sala, asvakarna, dhava, bamboo, kutaja arjuna, palmira, tilaka, trisaira, bilva, saptaparni trees karnikara plants with blossoms, mango trees and ashoka trees and dumped into the ocean.
